wiki.title: Jim Tomes
wiki.extract: Jim Tomes (born July 31, 1948) is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate, representing the Senate District 49 since 2010. He is a founder of the gun rights organization 2nd Amendment Patriots and has served as its director since its inception in January 1999. He has received support from the Tea Party and is a proponent for conservative causes including smaller government and opposition to reproductive freedom. For 33 years, he was a trucker and served as a union steward.
